judgment_text:
The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

Dr G. Jayachandran, J.:— Tax Case appeal has been filed by the Department. Further, they were not able to serve notice on the Assessee. Hence, we are constrained to dismiss the appeal for non-prosecution. Accordingly, this Tax Case appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution. No costs.
